about/index.title: About
about/index.description: geometor.etc is a digital reconstruction, semantic index, and symbolic modeling framework for Clark Kimberling’s monumental Encyclopedia of Triangle Centers (ETC) at the University of Evansville. Spanning more than 53,000 distinct…

bibliography.title: Bibliography
bibliography.description: Primary monographs, journals, catalogs, and research forums cited across the Encyclopedia of Triangle Centers.

people/angel-montesdeoca.title: Angel Montesdeoca
people/angel-montesdeoca.description: Spanish geometer and contributor of numerous triangle centers, perspectors, and conic constructions in the ETC.

people/antreas-hatzipolakis.title: Antreas Hatzipolakis
people/antreas-hatzipolakis.description: Founder of the Hyacinthos, Anopolis, and Euclid geometry research forums; proposer of hundreds of geometric configurations in the ETC.

people/bernard-gibert.title: Bernard Gibert
people/bernard-gibert.description: Creator of Cubics in the Triangle Plane (CTC), cataloging and analyzing over 1,200 triangle cubics (K001–K1200+) referenced throughout the ETC.

people/cesar-lozada.title: Cesar Lozada
people/cesar-lozada.description: Author of the Extended Glossary, Alphabetical Index of Terms, and Index of Triangles Referenced in ETC; contributor of thousands of triangle centers.

people/christian-heinrich-von-nagel.title: Christian Heinrich Von Nagel
people/christian-heinrich-von-nagel.description: German geometer who studied the Nagel point X_8 (perspector of the extouch triangle) and Nagel line in 1836.

people/clark-kimberling.title: Clark Kimberling
people/clark-kimberling.description: Mathematician at the University of Evansville; founder and creator of the Encyclopedia of Triangle Centers (ETC).

people/cyril-parry.title: Cyril Parry
people/cyril-parry.description: British geometer who discovered the Parry point X_111, the Parry circle, and the Parry reflection property.

people/dan-reznik.title: Dan Reznik
people/dan-reznik.description: Researcher on Poncelet porisms, locus invariants, and dynamic triangle center loci in the ETC.

people/dao-thanh-oai.title: Dao Thanh Oai
people/dao-thanh-oai.description: Geometer and discoverer of generalizations of the Simson line, Napoleon configuration, and perspective triangles in the ETC.

people/darij-grinberg.title: Darij Grinberg
people/darij-grinberg.description: Mathematician and early contributor to Hyacinthos and the ETC on barycentric coordinates, pedal triangles, and circle power identities.

people/dasari-naga-vijay-krishna.title: Dasari Naga Vijay Krishna
people/dasari-naga-vijay-krishna.description: Indian mathematician contributing synthetic reflection and circle constructions in the ETC.

people/emile-lemoine.title: Emile Lemoine
people/emile-lemoine.description: French mathematician and co-founder of modern triangle geometry; studied the symmedian point X_6 (Lemoine point) and Lemoine circles.

people/eric-weisstein.title: Eric Weisstein
people/eric-weisstein.description: Creator of MathWorld, providing extensive cross-linked articles and illustrations for triangle centers and central circles.

people/ernst-wilhelm-grebe.title: Ernst Wilhelm Grebe
people/ernst-wilhelm-grebe.description: German mathematician who investigated the symmedian point X_6 (Grebe point) in 1847.

people/evangelista-torricelli.title: Evangelista Torricelli
people/evangelista-torricelli.description: Italian physicist and mathematician who solved Fermat’s problem via equilateral triangles erected on the sides of ABC, locating X_13 and X_14.

people/floor-van-lamoen.title: Floor Van Lamoen
people/floor-van-lamoen.description: Dutch mathematician and triangle geometer, discoverer of the van Lamoen circle and numerous cevapoint and perspectivity constructions in the ETC.

people/gaston-darboux.title: Gaston Darboux
people/gaston-darboux.description: French geometer after whom the Darboux cubic (K004) and Darboux point X_20 (with De Longchamps) are named.

people/gohier-de-longchamps.title: Gohier De Longchamps
people/gohier-de-longchamps.description: French mathematician who studied the De Longchamps point X_20 (reflection of the orthocenter in the circumcenter) and De Longchamps line.

people/henri-brocard.title: Henri Brocard
people/henri-brocard.description: French mathematician and co-founder of modern triangle geometry; namesake of the Brocard points, Brocard angle ω, Brocard axis, Brocard circle, and Brocard triangles.

people/john-casey.title: John Casey
people/john-casey.description: Irish mathematician and Euclidean geometer celebrated for Casey’s theorem and foundational treatises on the modern geometry of the triangle and circle.

people/john-horton-conway.title: John Horton Conway
people/john-horton-conway.description: Mathematician who introduced Conway triangle notation (S, S_A, S_B, S_C, S_ω) and the Conway circle in triangle geometry.

people/joseph-diaz-gergonne.title: Joseph Diaz Gergonne
people/joseph-diaz-gergonne.description: French geometer after whom the Gergonne point X_7 (perspector of the intouch triangle) and Gergonne line are named.

people/joseph-neuberg.title: Joseph Neuberg
people/joseph-neuberg.description: Luxembourger-Belgian mathematician, co-founder of modern triangle geometry, discoverer of the Neuberg cubic (K001) and Neuberg circles.

people/karl-wilhelm-feuerbach.title: Karl Wilhelm Feuerbach
people/karl-wilhelm-feuerbach.description: German geometer who proved in 1822 that the nine-point circle is tangent to the incircle at the Feuerbach point X_11 and to the three excircles.

people/kiminari-shinagawa.title: Kiminari Shinagawa
people/kiminari-shinagawa.description: Geometer who introduced the Shinagawa coefficients (G, H) for triangle centers on the Euler line.

people/kurt-hofstadter.title: Kurt Hofstadter
people/kurt-hofstadter.description: Cognitive scientist and geometer who discovered the Hofstadter points, including the Hofstadter zero point X_359 and one point X_360.

people/leonhard-euler.title: Leonhard Euler
people/leonhard-euler.description: Swiss mathematician who proved in 1765 that the orthocenter X_4, circumcenter X_3, centroid X_2, and nine-point center X_5 are collinear on the Euler line.

people/paul-yiu.title: Paul Yiu
people/paul-yiu.description: Professor of Mathematics at Florida Atlantic University, founder of Forum Geometricorum, and pioneer of modern barycentric triangle geometry.

people/peter-moses.title: Peter Moses
people/peter-moses.description: Computational geometer and principal collaborator on the ETC, discoverer of thousands of barycentric combinations, coordinates, and circle/cubic properties.

people/peter-yff.title: Peter Yff
people/peter-yff.description: Geometer who discovered the Yff center of congruence X_174, Yff parabolic point X_190, and Yff central triangles.

people/pierre-de-fermat.title: Pierre De Fermat
people/pierre-de-fermat.description: French mathematician who posed the problem of finding the point X_13 minimizing the sum of distances |AX| + |BX| + |CX| to the vertices of ABC.

people/randy-hutson.title: Randy Hutson
people/randy-hutson.description: Prolific contributor to the ETC, specializing in synthetic constructions, perspective triangles, radical centers, and conjugate relationships.

people/stanley-rabinowitz.title: Stanley Rabinowitz
people/stanley-rabinowitz.description: Mathematician and author of ‘Location of Triangle Centers Relative to the Incircle and Circumcircle’ in the ETC.

people/theodor-spieker.title: Theodor Spieker
people/theodor-spieker.description: German geometer who discovered the Spieker center X_10 (incenter of the medial triangle and center of mass of the perimeter of ABC).
